files.services/catalog-sync/README.md:
# catalog-sync

catalog-sync streams product changes from the warehouse into the storefront
search index.

## Runtime settings

services/catalog-sync/settings.yaml holds the runtime settings. On top of the
keys the deployment manifest lists, the search team requires these keys to be
declared so the index rebuild can be throttled and metered:

- index_shard_count
- quota_calls_per_minute

The settings file is flat YAML.
files.services/catalog-sync/settings.yaml:
service_name: catalog-sync
listen_port: 7331
max_inflight_batches: 16
retry_backoff_ms: 400
index_shard_count: 8
